response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_figures AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS figure FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), all_region_average AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS average_figure FROM region_figures) SELECT r.region, r.figure, r.figure - a.average_figure AS amount_above_average, r.figure / NULLIF(a.average_figure, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM region_figures AS r CROSS JOIN all_region_average AS a WHERE r.figure > a.average_figure

assumptions.assumption: An account with no transactions has no average; AVG excludes it from its region's figure.
